characters.name: Amy
characters.clothing: A rough-spun charcoal-grey tunic, long-sleeved and reaching mid-thigh, tucked into muted brown woolen leggings that show faint scuffs from her daily work; over the tunic she wears a worn tan leather apron, heavily scarred by ale splashes and kitchen tools, tied at her waist with an iron buckle. Her feet are clad in sturdy dark-brown leather boots laced up to mid-calf, each heel slightly worn. A simple leather belt cinches between tunic and apron, holding a small pouch for coins
